origin.description: Fit every formula with the same fitter.

arguments.name: .formulas
arguments.text: A dict or list of formulas.

origin.details: A dict of formulas returns a dict of fits. The fitter used here is least squares.
origin.example:
fit <- fit_with(mtcars, lm, formulas(~disp, full = ~drat * cyl + am + vs))
cat(paste(names(coef(fit$full)), collapse = " "), "\n")

translation.description: Fit every formula with the same fitter.

arguments.name: .formulas
arguments.text: A dict or list of formulas.

translation.details: A dict of formulas returns a dict of fits. The fitter used here is least squares.
translation.example:
fits = fit_with(mtcars, lm, formulas("~disp", full="~drat * cyl + am + vs"))
print(" ".join(fits["full"].coefficients))
